items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: You mentioned the Decatur Street job that you had with George and Bernard Boyd.

ctx.x: other parts of the states, because I was a kid and I came from up there where I was born. But it was different. It was different here. The boys in town were playing a little different from the boys in the country. The boys in town seemed like they were a little more smoother. They played a little more smoother, I would say. I would say they had more techniques than the boys in the country. They did. They had more techniques. Because at that time, there wasn't but a very few music teachers in the country. I…
Now, let's see if we can tell about any more of the bands you played with around town here. You mentioned the Decatur Street job that you had with George and Bernard Boyd.
Well, I would say here in town from then, from the Decatur Street job... By the way, I happened to play drums with Buddy Pity a little while. Oh, you didn't?
